title: Repo entry
description: One declared repository: the payload of a repo:<id> document (the agent's /config/repos/<id>.json). Declares a repository the operator wants tracked; live git state (branch, dirty count, commits) is scanned separately by the heartbeat and never lives here.

local_path.description: Where the repo lives on disk. Absolute, or relative to the managed repos directory (data/repos) for anything cloned there.

access.description: Declared intent only - not filesystem-enforced. 'write' signals the agent may commit/push; 'read' signals inspect-only.

summary.description: Optional short note on what this repo is / why it's tracked.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this repo was declared. Runtime-stamped; preserve on edit.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit. Runtime-stamped on every write.
